REGISTER PLATES

  
Offset misregistration

  
2-PLATE


  

    
Two plates laid down out of register, the way a press lays them down
      when the sheet has shifted between passes. Press the control and they
      walk back into alignment — the colour collapsing out of the fringe and
      into the image. The error is the subject; registering it is what
      makes you see it.
